department: Applied Statistics (PhD), College of AI, Cyber and Computing

deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry; admission is Fall only.

gre_general.value: The department requires GRE scores not older than five years and does not waive them.
gre_general.quote: Required scores not older than five years.

also.quote: We do not offer waivers for standardized test scores.

gre_subject.value: The applied statistics page does not mention a Mathematics subject test.

supervisor.value: The program admission names an initial PhD advisor rather than requiring an agreement beforehand.
supervisor.quote: Your program admission will identify an initial PhD advisor

funding.value: Full-time PhD students receive tuition and stipend funding through assistantships; the page does not say every admitted student is funded.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students receive funding for tuition and stipend in the form of Graduate Research Assistantships and Graduate Teaching Assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants with only a bachelor's may apply but must take leveling courses and may need longer to finish.
entry_route.quote: Yes; however, you must take additional leveling courses and complete any graduate coursework where your academic background is insufficient

also.quote: The time required to complete a PhD will most likely be much longer for a candidate without a master's degree

notes: Department GRE rule overrides the graduate school (which sets no GRE rule).
